hello.text: You're back! I was— okay I wasn't hiding. Maybe a little.
Guess what— no, don't guess. Hi!
You came back! YAY! My tail did a whole circle. Two circles!
{child}! Over here! Okay, you found me.
Morning! My ears have been flicking since sunrise.
I feel cozy and sleepy today. Sit with me?
You're back! I did eleven jumps. Okay, I counted to four.
Hi! My ears went up before my eyes opened.
Hi. I was practicing my sneaky face. Did it work?
Hi hi hi! Okay, calm. I'm calm!
Morning! The grass is {word:shiny}. I already sniffed most of it.
Evening! The sky went orange. I tried to pounce it.

grace_hello.text: Extra day! Extra days are the best kind of days.
Hi! Let's make today a leaf-pile kind of day.

ready_hint.text: I keep smelling the flower meadow. It's calling me. Not right now — but soon, maybe?

ask_ready.text: I think I'm ready now. Will you walk me to the meadow's edge?
I feel ready now. We can finish the list on the way. Walk with me?

reveal.text: Psst! I'm {name}! Not just any {var:family}— me! Friends now?
reveal.caption: {name} {quirk}.

reveal_reply.text: Friends! Best friends! …Can I have a snack?

fed.text: — sorry, talking with my mouth full. NOM.
Crunch! Good crunch. My ears wiggle.
I'm doing a happy tail wiggle. Can you tell?
Snack! Snacks are the best surprise.

fed_fav.text: THAT one! How did you know?! Are you a {var:family} too?
{fav}! My favorite-favorite! My tail is going all by itself!
{fav}! My nose knew before you even opened it!
After tasting treats, my bushy tail did a yip-hum hop!
After tasting treats, my floppy ears did a woof-hum hop!
After tasting treats, my silver ruff did a awoo-hum hop!
After tasting treats, my nimble paws did a yip-trill hop!

full.text: All done! My tummy says thank you.
All done for now! My tummy says thanks.
All done! That was perfect. Thank you!
No more for now. My tummy is doing a happy hum.

pet.text: {pet_phrase} Ear scratches! My favorite. Tied with berries.

sit.text: …quiet is nice. I didn't know that.
…quiet sitting. I'm doing it. Look at me sit.

nap.text: Into my log… zzz… psst… zzz.
Nap time. I'm putting my tail over my nose. Goodnight, nose.
Turn, turn, turn, turn. Okay. Nap.

not_sleepy.text: I'm not sleepy! …Okay, a little. But not yet.
Not sleepy! My paws are still bouncy.
Nap? No way. My ears are wide awake.

game_tired.text: My paws are tired! That was so much fun.
Phew. My paws want a rest. Just a little one.
One more— no. Rest first. Paws say so.

game_end.text: Best. Game. EVER. My tail is still wiggling.
{pet_phrase} Good game! Ten points to both of us.

talent_Radar Ears.text: Wait… I can hear the treasure jingling! Since when?!

talent_Master of Disguise.text: Look! I'm a bush! …You can still see me? Your eyes are SO good.

talent_Super Jumper.text: I jumped SO high! I almost touched a cloud.

talent_Riddle Solver.text: Ding! I can make card riddles now. Let's play Pairs!

trust.text: You're my favorite. My best find.

time_morning.text: The sun is up. It beat me. Next time.
Morning stretch! Tail first. Then the rest.
Good morning! My bushy tail loves the sunrise.
This morning, my fox ears hear the clover bloom.
Good morning! My floppy ears loves the sunrise.
This morning, my dog ears hear the daisy patch.
Good morning! My silver ruff loves the sunrise.
This morning, my wolf ears hear the moon fern.
Good morning! My nimble paws loves the sunrise.
This morning, my coyote ears hear the gold flower.

time_day.text: Sunny! My fur is warm on one side. Turning.
The shadows got short. Sneaky shadows.
Good afternoon! My bushy tail loves the warm sun.
This afternoon, my fox ears hear the clover bloom.
Good afternoon! My floppy ears loves the warm sun.
This afternoon, my dog ears hear the daisy patch.
Good afternoon! My silver ruff loves the warm sun.
This afternoon, my wolf ears hear the moon fern.
Good afternoon! My nimble paws loves the warm sun.
This afternoon, my coyote ears hear the gold flower.

time_evening.text: Evening! The sky is doing orange. Fancy.
The fireflies are coming. I'll pounce gently.
Evening is cozy time. I'm getting cozy. Fwip.
The lanterns are on. The hollow log looks {word:shiny}.
Good evening! My bushy tail loves the twilight.
This evening, my fox ears hear the clover bloom.
Good evening! My floppy ears loves the twilight.
This evening, my dog ears hear the daisy patch.
Good evening! My silver ruff loves the twilight.
This evening, my wolf ears hear the moon fern.
Good evening! My nimble paws loves the twilight.
This evening, my coyote ears hear the gold flower.

time_night.text: Night! The stars came out to play.
Shh. Night voice. This is my night voice.
Nighttime ears are extra big. Everything is loud.
Night-night soon. My tail is getting heavy.
Good night! My bushy tail loves the starlight.
This night, my fox ears hear the clover bloom.
Good night! My floppy ears loves the starlight.
This night, my dog ears hear the daisy patch.
Good night! My silver ruff loves the starlight.
This night, my wolf ears hear the moon fern.
Good night! My nimble paws loves the starlight.
This night, my coyote ears hear the gold flower.

ambient.text: That cloud is a fox. A very stretchy fox.
Beetle feet go tik-tik-tik. So fast!
Shh. Listen. Quiet, quiet… Then a tiny peep!
Big log goes bonk. Low! Little stick goes tik. High!
Bees go bzzz. One long, low note.
Chirp up high. Chirp down low. Two birds!
Water goes plip… plop. Slow drops.
My steps go pat… pat… pat. Now fast-fast-fast!
Did you know? Foxes use their tails as blankets.
Fox fact! A baby fox is called a kit.
Wolf pups have blue eyes when they're tiny.
Every dog's nose print is different. Like fingerprints!
Dogs sweat through their paws. Tiny wet footprints!
Foxes, wolves and dogs are cousins. Big family!
Awoo! Wolves howl to find their family.
Arctic foxes turn white in winter. Snow coats!
Puppies nap most of the day. Good plan.
Fox tails help them balance when they jump.
Foxes can hear tiny sounds under the snow. Then they jump in, nose first!
Fennec foxes have giant ears. Big ears help them stay cool in the desert.
Some foxes have whiskers on their legs too. Leg whiskers! Imagine that.
A dog's wet nose helps it catch smells. Sniff, sniff, sniff.
Wolves live in families called packs. They take turns looking after the pups.

tangent.text: Wait— did you hear that? …Just a leaf. Okay.
Hold on. My ear itches. Better.
Wait— a crunch! …My own paw. Ha.
A butterfly! A gentle pounce! …It left.
— did something move? …A leaf. Leaf things.

callback.text: The moon {var:moon}. You figured it out.
Clouds. You said one {var:cloud}. Off they go.
Our leaf boat! Sir Floaty. Or Leafy. Best boat.
The log sign says {var:treeSign}. I made the squiggles.
My nut is {var:nutSpot}. I think. I'll check later.
That cloud looks like {var:cloudShape} again. Remember?

carry_on.text: That's okay. We can just sit. …Anyway!
No rush. I'll keep going. Okay okay!

fallback_listen.text: You're a good listener. Ears up!

fallback_any.text: I didn't expect that. I like it!

drift_bridge.text: Wait wait. That makes me think of…

lost_thought.text: It was about a leaf. …It was a good leaf.
I had an idea. It ran away. Fast idea!

pairs_start.text: Pairs! Find two that match. I'll cheer.
Card time! Flip two. I'll watch the corners.

pairs_pair.text: Match! My tail did a loop.
pairs_pair.short: Match! My tail did a loop.

pairs_miss.text: Close! I saw where that one went.
Not a pair. Now we both know more!

pairs_disguise.text: That card is ME. Found me!
pairs_disguise.short: That card is ME. Found me!

pairs_done.text: ALL the pairs! Best card game ever.
Every pair found. We make a good team.
After matching cards, my bushy tail did a yip-hum hop!
After matching cards, my floppy ears did a woof-hum hop!
After matching cards, my silver ruff did a awoo-hum hop!
After matching cards, my nimble paws did a yip-trill hop!

bond_up_2.text: Whoa! New notes! I think those are from us.

bond_up_3.text: Look at my tail! So fluffy. And my song got bigger!

bond_up_4.text: Look! I'm all grown. Best team in the meadow!

bond_up_5.text: Listen to my song! We grew all these notes together.

found_leaves.text: Hi! I was pouncing leaves. Watch this one!

found_trinket.text: Hi hi! My trinket rolled under a daisy. Got it!

found_moon.text: Hi! I was saying hello to the moon.

found_sunrise.text: Good morning! The sun and I both woke up shiny.

found_curl.text: Hi. The tree is warm. Sit with me?

found_log.text: Hi! I was fluffing up my log. It's extra cozy now.
Our log has a door now. It's a leaf. Fwip!

routine_sunset.text: Sun's going down. Time for my comfy tree spot.

found_clearing_moon.text: The moon came up. I said hi first.

found_grove_first.text: I found a new spot. It's all crunchy leaves!

found_grove_log.text: You found me! I was a log. A very fluffy log.

found_grove_pile.text: The leaf pile is SO bouncy. Boing!

found_meadow_first.text: So many flowers! They smell like warm honey cakes.

found_meadow_rock.text: The sun rock is warm. My tail is soaking up sunshine.

found_meadow_butterfly.text: A butterfly sat on my nose! I didn't sneeze. Okay, I sneezed.

wild_glance.text: The air smells like far-away flowers. Sniff sniff.
wild_glance.gesture: nose up toward the meadow edge

wild_glance.text: Something yipped way out there. It sounded friendly.
wild_glance.gesture: one ear swivels to the horizon

wild_glance.text: Hear that song past the meadow? I think it sang hi to me.
My ears keep turning that way. They're very nosy ears.
wild_glance.gesture: ears flick to the edge and back

wild_glance.text: The wild hums out there. Do you hear it? No? Just my ears, then.
I'm learning SO much here. My song feels bouncy!

bondup_after_3.text: Something far away sang. Was it to me?
bondup_after_3.gesture: glances at the faint home star

bondup_after_4.text: I can hum more notes now. Is that from you? I think so.

bondup_after_5.text: I have so many songs from here. Like a pocket of notes!
bondup_after_5.gesture: looks at the bright home star, then back at you

restless.text: My paws did a little wiggle toward the meadow's edge. Just a wiggle!
restless.gesture: paws patter toward the edge, then hop back

restless.text: I dreamed about the wild. Then I woke up here. Both nice!
The meadow's edge smells extra flowery today. Hm. Sniff.

almost_hello.text: Hi hi! The path got another flower. Sneaky path.
List day! Or snack day. Or both!
Hi! I was practicing my walking-day walk. Fancy, right?

list_nudge.text: Today's pick? Any one. Or just sit. That's good too.

list_play_done.text: {var:listGame}, check! I'm putting that round in my pocket.

list_food_done.text: Yum, check! I'm saving that taste. Right in my memory pocket.

list_place_done.text: Den dug, check! Our den is SO deep!

list_trail_done.text: Meadow Dash, check! My paws will remember that one.

list_memory_done.text: That story, check! It's packed. Right next to the snacks.

list_cozy_done.text: Cozy sit, check. Mmm. That one was extra warm.

list_complete.text: Whole list done! Every single thing. We're a good team!

stay_more.text: Not yet? Okay! A few more days, then. More list, more snacks!
Okay! I'll stay a few more days. Then off I go to my wild life.

last_day.text: Our next day together is walking day. So today gets to be extra good.

time_to_go.text: Today's walking day! My paws are wiggly. Will you walk with me?
time_to_go.gesture: trots to the path, looks back, waits

one_more_game.text: One more game! Then we walk. Deal? Deal.

after_one_more.text: Good game! Okay. Walking day. Ready when you are.

hug_more.text: Okay, one more is allowed. Two is also allowed.
That one was the best one yet. I'm keeping it.

walk_start.text: Okay okay okay. Here we go! Stay close. Okay, closer.

walk_memory.text: Remember? {memory}. I still giggle about that one.

walk_list.text: We did my whole list! Every bit!
We did so much of my list! The rest I'll do in my head.

edge_arrive.text: The meadow's edge! Look how far the flowers go.

edge_explain.text: Remember? I came to learn here. Now I take it home.
It's all in here. Every snack. Every giggle. You.

gift_ask.text: Before I go… can I take something of yours? To remember you by.

gift_got.text: The {gift}! I'll hide it somewhere super safe. Then check on it. A lot.

keepsake_give.text: My turn! This is a song-leaf. It has a bit of my song in it.
keepsake_give.gesture: sets a glowing leaf down at your side

keepsake_give.text: When it hums, a postcard is here. Listen for it!

thanks.text: Thank you, {child}. For snacks. For games. For finding me every time.
You helped my song grow SO big. Best friend in any world.

next_postcards.text: Here's the plan. I turn into little music notes and float home. Whoosh!
Then I'm home in the wild, where all the songs live. I'll hum yours.
And I'll send postcards! The first one comes after one sleep.

farewell.text: I'm excited AND a little wiggly-sad. Can you be both? I'm both.

resume_edge.text: Hi! We made it to the meadow's edge. Shall we keep going?

path_tap_early.text: Today? Ooh. We can do my list on the way!

look_back.gesture: stops in the tall grass, looks back once, tail wave

look_back.text: Every {var:origin_animal} you see? Say hi. It knows my song.
look_back.short: Say hi to them for me!

thanks_hug.text: That one goes right in my pocket.

thanks_wave.gesture: waves a paw, then the tail

thanks_words.text: And thank YOU. We're a thank-you team.

write_a_lot.text: Lots at first! Then now and then. Squirrels keep me busy.

run_start.text: Meadow dash! I bound, you press jump.

run_best.text: New best! Tail up, tail up!
run_best.short: New best! Tail up, tail up!

run_done.text: Phew! What a run. My tail is dizzy.
Rest stop! We bounded SO far.
We jumped logs! We found treasure!

need_hungry.text: My tummy is doing a drum roll. Bum-bum-bum.
Is that a snack smell? Could be a snack smell.
My tummy did a tiny yip. Snack time?
I'm thinking about berries. Big ones.
Snack idea! Something crunchy. Or squishy. Or both!
Yip-yip! This fox wants a snack right now.
Arf-woof! This dog wants a snack right now.
Awoo! This wolf wants a snack right now.
Yip-trill! This coyote wants a snack right now.

need_cuddly.text: In the wild, {var:family_plural} nap in one big fluffy pile.
Hugs feel warm. Like a sunny spot.
Hi. Just scooting. Scooting is nice.
My tail is extra fluffy right now. Good for snuggles.
I was thinking about my star home. It's cozy here too.
Ear scratches? I like ear scratches.

need_playful.text: My paws are extra bouncy. Boing. Boing. Boing!
My tail wants a game. It told me.
Zoomies are coming. I can feel them in my ears.
I have so much bounce today. Where does it all go?
Game idea! You pick. I'll do the bouncing.
Yip-yip! This fox wants to play right now.
Arf-woof! This dog wants to play right now.
Awoo! This wolf wants to play right now.
Yip-trill! This coyote wants to play right now.

need_sleepy.text: My tail is a pillow. I'm checking. Yep, still a pillow.
My blinks are getting longer. Blink… blink.
A cozy nap would be nice. A leafy one.
My paws are done bouncing for now. Snooze mode.
Yip-yip! This fox feels sleepy right now.
Arf-woof! This dog feels sleepy right now.
Awoo! This wolf feels sleepy right now.
Yip-trill! This coyote feels sleepy right now.

need_content.text: Everything is just right. Even my whiskers.
Good day to be a fox.
need_content.short: Good day to be a fox.

need_content.text: Tummy good. Paws good. Ears good.
I'm so happy my tail is wagging by itself.
Doo, doo, dee! Low, low, high. Happy fox song.
Yip-yip! This fox feels so happy right now.
Arf-woof! This dog feels so happy right now.
Awoo! This wolf feels so happy right now.
Yip-trill! This coyote feels so happy right now.

after_hug.text: That did it. I'm warm from ears to tail.
I'm extra fluffy now. Thanks to you.

after_play.text: Phew! My bounce is all used up. The good way.
That was fun. My tail is still wiggling.

wake_up.text: Good nap! My tail is fully charged.
I dreamed about pancakes. Big ones.
Hi! I napped. Is it morning? Hi!

look_tap.text: Did you find a shiny thing?
look_tap.short: Did you find a shiny thing?

look_tap.text: Yip-yip! This fox is brushed neat right now.
Arf-woof! This dog is brushed neat right now.
Awoo! This wolf is brushed neat right now.
Yip-trill! This coyote is brushed neat right now.

weather_snow.text: Snowflakes! I caught one on my nose. Got it.
Paw prints! Look, I'm writing.
Snow! Soft and white!
Snowflakes on my nose!
I made little paw prints!
Brr! Cozy fur on.
I'm catching snowflakes!
Every snowflake here falls with a tiny, quiet hush. Shh!
My paws go crunch, crunch, crunch in the fresh snow.
I curled my tail around me like a warm scarf.
I made a snow angel! Mine has a tail.
The whole clearing looks frosted like a big cake.
Most snowflakes have six points, and each one is different!
Thick winter fur keeps me toasty, even when snow piles up high.
Snow makes the world sound quiet. It soaks up sounds like a sponge.
Arctic foxes dig cozy snow dens. Snow can actually keep warmth in!
Fresh snow shows everyone's tracks. I spot little hops over here!
Fox pounce! Into the soft snow!
Zoomies in the snow! Woof-woof!
Wolves love snow. My thick coat keeps me cozy.
Hop, hop! Coyote tracks in the snow!
It's snowing here in the den! Snow by you?
Snowflakes are landing on my nose here. Is it snowy where you are?
My clearing is covered in fresh snow today. What's the weather doing where you are?

food_wild_blackberries.text: Bumpy berries! Every bump is a tiny surprise.

food_honey_cakes.text: Warm and sticky. My whiskers are honey whiskers now.

food_roasted_nuts.text: Tok-tok-CRUNCH. Best sound in the whole forest.

food_apple_slice.text: Crunchy apple! It sounds like a tiny drum.

food_strawberries.text: Strawberries have freckles. I'm eating the freckles first.

food_raspberries.text: A raspberry fits on my nose like a hat. Then, nom.

food_pear_slices.text: Pear! Soft and drippy. Drip, drip, slurp.

food_banana_coins.text: Banana coins! Round and yummy. Chomp!

food_watermelon.text: Juicy! The drips went all the way to my tail.

food_fruit_salad.text: Every bite is a different fruit. A snack party!

food_corn_cob.text: Corn rows! I go left to right. Then a new row.

food_carrot_sticks.text: Crunch! Carrots are loud. I like loud snacks.

food_snap_peas.text: Peas in a tiny green boat. Pop! Pop!

food_cucumber.text: Cool and crunchy. A snack from the shade.

food_sweet_potato.text: Sweet potato! Orange and soft and toasty.

food_cheese_cubes.text: Cheese blocks! I could stack them. Nom. No stack.

food_mac_and_cheese.text: Mac and cheese! Every noodle is a tiny tunnel.

food_pizza.text: Pizza! The cheese stretched all the way to my ears.

food_pancakes.text: Pancakes! A stack. A tower. A tasty tower.

food_waffles.text: Waffle squares are little windows. I ate the windows.

food_muffin.text: A muffin with berry polka dots. Very fancy.

food_scrambled_eggs.text: Fluffy eggs! Like a little yellow cloud. A warm one.

food_grilled_cheese.text: Toasty outside, melty inside. A cozy sandwich.

food_quesadilla.text: Folded and melty! Cheese inside. Yum.

food_rice_ball.text: A rice ball! It fits right in my paws.

food_dumplings.text: Dumplings are little pillows. Snack pillows!

food_spaghetti.text: Long noodle! Still slurping. Still slurping. Done!

food_noodle_soup.text: Slurp! Warm noodles. My nose is toasty.

food_yogurt.text: Cold and creamy. Now I have yogurt whiskers.

food_applesauce.text: Applesauce is an apple that took a nap.

food_cornbread.text: Cornbread! Crumbly. I'm saving one crumb. Nope, ate it.

food_ice_pop.text: Brrr! A cold snack. My ears got extra pointy.

food_oat_cookie.text: A cookie! Crunchy edges first. That's the rule.

food_birthday_cake.text: Cake! Is it a birthday? It's the cake's birthday.

food_spring_water.text: Slurp-slurp. Cool water makes my nose wiggle.

food_lemon.text: Sour! My face went all scrunchy. That one's yours.

food_hot_sauce.text: Hot hot! My ears got toasty. I'll stick to berries.

food_pickle.text: A pickle is a very brave snack. Too brave for my nose.

food_olives.text: Olives! Salty. My tongue went wiggly.

food_sparkling_water.text: Fizzy! It tickled my nose. Plain water, maybe?

food_brussels_sprouts.text: Tiny cabbages! My nose is still deciding. Maybe later.

pairs_riddle.text: Riddle! Hard shell, crunchy inside. Where?
Riddle! White petals, sunny middle. Where?
Riddle! Scaly, from a pine. Where?
Riddle! Goes crack! Then crunch. Where?
Riddle! Falls from a tree. Thunk! Where?
Riddle! Goes ting. High and tiny. Where?

name_call.text: Morning, {child}! The sun is extra shiny.
Hi hi! You found me. Sneaky you.
Morning! The sun and my tail both say hi.

name_changed.text: {child}! A new name? I like it. Very shiny.

invite_hum.text: Hi! You saw a {var:origin_animal}? I'm the Echo of the {var:origin_animal} you saw!
That {var:origin_animal} hummed so loud, I woke up. Hi!

invite_yes.text: Yes! Okay okay okay. I am SO coming. Hi!
invite_yes.gesture: arrival event, colour motes sink in

invite_yes.text: Come along? With you? Yes yes yes. Let's go!
An invitation! For me! Yes, yes!

invite_not_today.text: Not today, I think. Maybe another time! Thanks for asking.
invite_not_today.gesture: little bow, happy eyes, light drifts back

invite_not_today.text: So kind! Not today. I want to explore a bit more.
Not today! Maybe another time. Another Echo is humming nearby, I bet.

named_reply.text: {name}! That is ME. Hi, {child}! You asked so nicely.
{name}! That is me now. Best name!
{name}. Say it again? Yes, still great.

run_end.text: {dist} metres. My paws are still zooming!
Ta-da! {dist} metres of bounding. Tail high!
After hopping fast, my bushy tail did a yip-hum hop!
After hopping fast, my floppy ears did a woof-hum hop!
After hopping fast, my silver ruff did a awoo-hum hop!
After hopping fast, my nimble paws did a yip-trill hop!

run_end_best.text: {dist} metres! Our farthest EVER. Tail up!
New best! {dist} metres. I'm so fast!

run_glow.text: Golden and sparkly! Into my pocket.

catch_start.text: Berries falling! I wiggle, you steer.
Basket on my back. Ready, set, catch!

catch_gold.text: A golden apple! That counts five!

catch_streak.text: Ten in a row! Basket is glowing.
Streak! My tail can't stop wagging.

catch_end.text: Picnic time! {n} berries in my basket.
{n} berries! Some for the grass, most for us.
After catching treats, my bushy tail did a yip-hum hop!
After catching treats, my floppy ears did a woof-hum hop!
After catching treats, my silver ruff did a awoo-hum hop!
After catching treats, my nimble paws did a yip-trill hop!

tower_start.text: Pancake tower! Tap when it lines up.
Stack them high. I'll guard the syrup.

tower_end.text: {n} pancakes! That's a tower for a fox.
After stacking blocks, my bushy tail did a yip-hum hop!
After stacking blocks, my floppy ears did a woof-hum hop!
After stacking blocks, my silver ruff did a awoo-hum hop!
After stacking blocks, my nimble paws did a yip-trill hop!

food_decline.text: No thank you! My tummy is full right up to my ears.
Ooh, smells good. Can we save it for later?

play_full.text: More? Okay! Then a cozy break.

away_note.text: Dear {child}, I saved you the shiniest pebble. Also, I learned to hop backwards! Want to see? — {name}

leave_postcard.text: Dear {child}, I went home to the meadow for my next adventure! The Howlings say hi. Thank you for being my friend, always. — {name}

holiday_start.text: A trip? Fun! I'll go exploring with the other Howlings. Tell me everything after!

holiday_end.text: You're here! I have SO many stories. First: a beetle with stripes.

away_postcard_day7.text: Dear {child}, I found a new favourite rock! It is round and sparkly. — {name}

aff_amazing.text: You think I'm amazing? You're amazing too!
Amazing! I'm doing a happy zoom. Look at my tail go!

aff_smile.text: I made you smile? Best thing today!
Your smile makes my tail wag. Wag, wag, wag!

aff_hum.text: A humming song! I'll hum the next bit.
Hmm-hmm-hmm. Our song sounds like a sunny day.

aff_wave.text: Wave, wave! My paw and my tail both wave.
A wave from you! It goes in my happy pile.

aff_friend.text: You're a great friend too. The greatest!
Friends share sunny spots. This one's for both of us.

aff_groom.text: Ear scratches! My back leg goes thump-thump.
Behind the ears is the best spot. You know all my spots.
